_bc_done=$(ls "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/run-step5-review"*.done.* 2>/dev/null | tail -1)

echo "Breadcrumb files:"
echo "  stream: $_bc_files"
echo "  done: $_bc_done"
echo "  status: $_bc_status"

# Poll until done sentinel has content
count=0
while [ $count -lt 240 ]; do
  if [ -n "$_bc_done" ] && [ -s "$_bc_done" ]; then

  fi
  sleep 15
  count=$((count + 1))
  echo "Waiting for review... ${count}x15s ($(date +%H:%M:%S))"
done
